annotations.title: LGA · Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander residents

description:
How many residents are Aboriginal, Torres Strait Islander or both, and what share of the area that is, for every suburb and council area.

Coverage: About 11,000 suburbs and localities and 545 council areas across Australia, in all states and territories (areas with too few people or homes for reliable figures are left out); one snapshot at 10 August 2021. Current to 2021-08-10. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/indigenous-status`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: total_population, indigenous_count, indigenous_pct, aboriginal_count, aboriginal_pct, torres_strait_islander_count, torres_strait_islander_pct, both_aboriginal_and_torres_strait_islander_count, both_aboriginal_and_torres_strait_islander_pct, non_indigenous_count, non_indigenous_pct, indigenous_status_not_stated_count, indigenous_status_not_stated_pct. Omit for all.

lga_name.description: Council (LGA) name exactly as /v1/lga/list returns it, e.g. `Lake Macquarie`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.
